title: Declared WCS Solution (when present)
description: Astrometric World Coordinate System parameters. Never invented. Pixel origin matches detection centroids (0-based image pixels). Absent or incomplete WCS must fail closed. projection_model distinguishes local-linear-CD (simple declared metadata approximation), TAN / TAN-SIP (FITS header via astropy.wcs), and other-fits-wcs. frame is a caller/header-declared label and must not be read as proof of an established plate solution.

frame.description: Caller-declared celestial reference frame label (e.g. ICRS). Not evidence that this record is a spherical ICRS plate solution.

crpix.description: Reference pixel (x, y) in the same 0-based pixel grid as detection centroids

crval_deg.description: Sky coordinates at CRPIX as [ra_deg, dec_deg]

cd_deg_per_pixel.description: 2x2 CD matrix in degrees per pixel: [[cd1_1, cd1_2], [cd2_1, cd2_2]] mapping (dx, dy) to (dra, ddec) in a local-linear-CD flat-sky approximation (not spherical TAN/SIP).

source_reference.description: Optional citation for the WCS provenance (FITS header hash, plate-solve receipt, etc.)

projection_model.description: local-linear-CD: flat-sky CD approximation for simple declared metadata. TAN / TAN-SIP: spherical projection from FITS via astropy.wcs. other-fits-wcs: celestial FITS WCS with a non-TAN CTYPE.

coordinate_standing.description: Epistemic standing of projected coordinates; never established sky truth by itself.

fits_crpix_1based.description: Original FITS CRPIX (1-based) before conversion to 0-based crpix.

wcs_header_cards.description: Minimal FITS WCS cards for round-trip TAN/SIP projection via astropy.wcs (present-only).
